news.title_ru: Затронуто 267 664 XRP: приложение XRP Ledger Wallet отключено после взлома

news.title: Solana (SOL) to Triple Transaction Size as Major Upgrade Goes Live
news.body: Solana is preparing to triple its maximum transaction size in a major network upgrade on Sept. 9.
news.title_ru: Solana (SOL) увеличит размер транзакции втрое по мере запуска масштабного обновления

news.title: MicroStrategy Puts Its Bitcoin Identity on a $250 Pair of Nike Jordans
news.body: Strategy's Bitcoin Jordans turn its treasury brand into a $250 sneaker, but checkout accepts cards and Apple Pay instead of Bitcoin. The post MicroStrategy Puts Its Bitcoin Identity on a $250 Pair of Nike Jordans appeared first on 99Bitcoins.
news.title_ru: MicroStrategy помещает свой биткойн-идентичность на пару кроссовок Nike Jordans за 250 долларов
